reviewed_records.label: Assistant Message
reviewed_records.depicts: A robot-like chat bubble with a message panel.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Could be confused with a generic chatbot brand mark if used without conversation context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show that a message or reply came from an AI assistant or automated agent.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when labeling assistant-authored replies, agent chat threads, or bot conversation surfaces.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for human-to-human chat, generic messaging, or broad AI branding with no message context.

reviewed_records.label: AI Reasoning
reviewed_records.depicts: A brain shape with circuit-style nodes and branches.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can read as generic AI or smart-tech branding if no nearby reasoning context is present.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show AI reasoning, model cognition, or an intelligent processing step.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product needs to communicate AI reasoning, inference, or an intelligence-heavy processing stage.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for human psychology, learning content, or generic settings with no AI meaning.

reviewed_records.label: Scan And Search
reviewed_records.depicts: Focus brackets around a magnifying glass.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Could be used as generic search if the interface does not clearly imply inspection or scanning.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show scanning, inspection, or retrieval-driven search over content or data.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when an agent or system is searching by first scanning, inspecting, or analyzing content.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for a plain site search field when no scan or analysis meaning is intended.

reviewed_records.label: Workflow
reviewed_records.depicts: Connected boxes forming a simple process flow.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: May be mistaken for a generic diagram if used without process context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a multi-step workflow, orchestration path, or linked automation sequence.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to show a linked sequence of automated or agent-driven steps.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for a simple hierarchy, organization chart, or generic navigation pattern.

reviewed_records.label: Confirmed Success
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Could be overused for trust or security confirmation where a shield-check would be more precise.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a successful, completed, or confirmed state.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when a task, step, validation, or operation has completed successfully.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for blocked, warning, or security-specific verification states.

reviewed_records.label: Alert
reviewed_records.depicts: An exclamation-style alert mark inside a circle.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Less severe-looking than an error or failure icon, so it fits warning and attention better than hard failure.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a warning, alert, or attention-needed state that is not full failure.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product needs to surface a notable issue, warning, or attention-needed condition.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for success, prohibition, or explicit failure where a stronger symbol is clearer.

reviewed_records.label: Trusted And Protected
reviewed_records.depicts: A shield outline with a checkmark.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can overlap with generic success, but the shield makes it clearly about trust or protection.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show verified protection, trusted status, or a confirmed security safeguard.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when something has passed a trust, safety, or protection check.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for plain success states unrelated to trust, protection, or verification.

reviewed_records.label: Trend Up
reviewed_records.depicts: An upward-trending line with an arrow.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can be misread as navigation to the upper-right if used without metric or trend context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show positive trend movement, growth, or improving performance over time.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to show positive metric movement or an improving trend.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use as a generic directional arrow or navigation control.

reviewed_records.label: Blocked
reviewed_records.depicts: A prohibition circle with a diagonal slash.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can overlap with cancellation, but the slash shape makes the meaning closer to blocked or not allowed.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show that an action, object, or state is blocked, prohibited, or not allowed.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to communicate prohibition, restriction, or blocked availability.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for simple failure, dismissal, or closed-state meanings where an X icon is clearer.

reviewed_records.label: Failed Or Rejected
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: May overlap with close or dismiss controls if used in tight UI spaces without text.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show a failed, rejected, cancelled, or negative-result state.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when a process, validation, or outcome clearly failed or was rejected.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for prohibition or restriction where a slash icon communicates the meaning better.

reviewed_records.label: Enabled Toggle
reviewed_records.depicts: A horizontal toggle switch in the on position.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can be mistaken for a generic UI control if used without settings or state context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show that a setting, control, or feature is switched on or enabled.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the product needs to communicate an enabled setting or an active on-state.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use as a general success mark or power symbol with no toggle meaning.

reviewed_records.label: Achievement
reviewed_records.depicts: A trophy cup with handles and a base.
reviewed_records.visual_confusion_notes: Can be read as generic success, ranking, or reward depending on context.
reviewed_records.purpose: Show an achievement, award, milestone, or winning outcome.
reviewed_records.use_when: Use when the interface needs to celebrate an achievement, reward, milestone, or top result.
reviewed_records.avoid_when: Do not use for ordinary completion states where a simple success icon is enough.
